title: How much can Claude read at once?

scenes.narration: Do you know Claude can read a five hundred page book in one go?
scenes.onscreen: Claude can read 500 pages at once
scenes.visual: Coral background, tag 'Do you know?', white card with the headline revealed word by word

scenes.narration: It's called the context window. Think of it as Claude's working memory for one conversation.
scenes.onscreen: The context window: Claude's working memory
scenes.visual: Off-white background, headline with 'context window' highlighted, card underneath

scenes.narration: Claude does not count words. It counts tokens. One token is about three quarters of a word.
scenes.visual: Tag 'Tokens', large equation in a card

scenes.narration: The standard window is two hundred thousand tokens. That is roughly one hundred fifty thousand words.
Some newer Claude models go up to one million tokens.
So paste the whole report, not just a piece. Then ask your question.
scenes.onscreen: Paste the whole report. Then ask.

scenes.narration: Follow Claude for all for more.
scenes.onscreen: Claude4All. Follow for more. Unofficial channel

sources.claim: The 200K-token context window is about 500 pages of text
Context window is the working memory for a conversation; some current models have a 1M-token window
One token is about 0.75 English words, so 200K tokens is about 150,000 words (rule of thumb; not stated in Anthropic's docs)
